_source: The owner's spec for the RIZEL'S DESK sample (Nov 17): notes, questions and answers as written there, on the samples' made-up timeline (2035/03/12 09:00 JST). The weekly issue is a fictional sample built in the real issue's structure (scripts/research/weekly_generator.py compose); its NVDA and AMD figures are those of watch22-dives.json. None of it is real data.

notes.bodyJa: 半導体がまとめて下がる日。売る前に、どの会社の何がきっかけかだけは確認しておきたい。
notes.bodyEn: It's a day when semiconductors all drop together. Before selling, I want to at least check which company and what caused it.

notes.bodyJa:
決算日に見ているのはこの2つ。

[red]**・次の四半期の見通し**[/red]
[red]**・それを聞いた後の時間外の反応**[/red]

売上と利益が予想を超えたかどうかはそのあとで十分。
notes.bodyEn:
There are two things I focus on during earnings day.

[red]**• The outlook for the next quarter**[/red]
[red]**• How the stock reacts after-hours once that outlook is announced**[/red]

Whether sales and profits beat estimates comes second.

notes.bodyJa: 時間外で+7%でも、まずは==出来高==をみる。少なすぎるなら明日のザラ場で戻ることもよくあるから。
notes.bodyEn: Even if it goes up 7% in after-hours trading, I first check the ==volume==. If it's too low, the price often pulls back during regular trading hours the next day.

ask.bodyJa:
持っている銘柄が増えすぎて、管理が大変です。
おすすめは何銘柄でしょうか？
ask.bodyEn: I have too many stocks, and it's difficult to manage them. How many stocks do you recommend holding?
ask.answerJa:
決算のたびに中身を確認できる数までにしています。
追えていない銘柄は、持っている理由を説明できるかで整理するといいですよ！
ask.answerEn: I keep the number of stocks manageable so I can review their details each earnings season. For stocks you're not actively following, it's helpful to organize them based on whether you can explain why you own them!

answered.bodyJa: 決算は良かったのに株価が大きく下がりました…何が起きているのか分かりません😭
answered.bodyEn: The earnings were good, but the stock price dropped significantly… I don't understand what's happening 😭
answered.answerJa:
株価が見ているのは、今回の数字より次の見通しなんですよね。

確認するのはこの3つです。
・会社が出した次の四半期の見通し
・市場の予想と比べてどうだったか
・決算の前にどれだけ上がっていたか

期待で先に上がっていた分、少しでも物足りないと売られます。会社がダメになったのか、期待が高すぎただけなのか。そこを分けて考えると落ち着けますよ。
answered.answerEn:
The stock price is focused more on future outlooks than on the current numbers.

There are three things to check:
• The company's forecast for the next quarter
• How that forecast compares to market expectations
• How much the stock price had risen before the earnings announcement

If the price had already risen on anticipation, even a slight shortfall in the outlook can lead to selling. You need to consider whether the company is actually struggling or if the expectations were just too high. Understanding this distinction can help you stay calm.

answered.bodyJa: 含み損が20%を超えました。損切りすべきか毎日悩んでいます。
answered.bodyEn: I have an unrealized loss exceeding 20%. I worry every day whether I should cut my losses.
answered.answerJa: 買った理由がまだ崩れていないなら、下がっただけで売る必要はないと思います。ただ毎日悩むなら、量が多すぎるサインかもしれません。
answered.answerEn: If the reasons you bought the stock haven't changed, I don't think you need to sell just because the price has dropped. However, if you find yourself worrying every day, it might be a sign that you're holding too large a position.

ja.headline: 決算は過去最高。でも株価が見ているのは「次」でした
ja.lead: NVDAの決算から10日ほど。売上は4四半期続けて過去最高でも、半導体株は上げ下げをくり返しています。正直、数字より[red]**次の四半期の見通し**[/red]に反応している週でした。

parts.heading: 今週の主な結論
parts.body:
・NVDAの売上は1,218.5億ドルで、4四半期続けて過去最高。次の四半期の見通しは1,290〜1,350億ドルで、まだ伸びが続くという見方です。
・一方で粗利益率の見通しは73.5%と、今回の74.6%を下回りました。利益率がどこで止まるかが、次の焦点になりそうです。
・AMDはデータセンター部門が売上の52%に。AI向けの需要がNVDA以外にも広がっているのかもしれません。

parts.note: 売上の見通しは、会社が出した1,290〜1,350億ドルの真ん中の値です。

parts.heading: AMDは、強い部分と弱い部分がはっきり分かれました
parts.body:
データセンター部門の売上は69.5億ドルで、前期から18.2%増。売上の==52%==を占めました。
パソコン・ゲーム向けは、売上も利益率も下がっています。
**伸びている部門に期待が集まる**という見方です。次の決算では、その伸びが続くかを確かめましょう。

en.headline: Record earnings, but the stock was watching what comes next
en.lead: It has been about ten days since NVDA's earnings. Revenue set a record for the fourth quarter in a row, yet chip stocks kept going up and down. Honestly, this was a week that reacted to the [red]**outlook for the next quarter**[/red] more than to the numbers.

parts.heading: This week's key takeaways
parts.body:
・NVDA revenue was $121.85B, a record for the fourth quarter in a row. The outlook for next quarter is $129B–$135B, which suggests growth is still continuing.
・The gross margin outlook of 73.5% is below this quarter's 74.6%. Where margins settle looks like the next key question.
・At AMD, Data Center reached 52% of revenue. Demand for AI may be spreading beyond NVDA.

items.text: NVDA revenue was $121.85B, a record for the fourth quarter in a row. The outlook for next quarter is $129B–$135B, which suggests growth is still continuing.
The gross margin outlook of 73.5% is below this quarter's 74.6%. Where margins settle looks like the next key question.
At AMD, Data Center reached 52% of revenue. Demand for AI may be spreading beyond NVDA.

parts.heading: NVDA set a revenue record, but margins slipped a little
parts.note: The revenue outlook is the midpoint of the company's $129B–$135B range.

parts.heading: AMD's strong and weak parts were clearly split
parts.body:
Data Center revenue was $6.95B, up 18.2% from the previous quarter, and made up ==52%== of revenue.
Client and Gaming saw both revenue and margins fall.
The view is that **expectations gather around the growing segment**. In the next report, let's check whether that growth continues.

parts.heading: Chip stocks this week: up, then down, then a partial rebound

points.comment: Buyers moved first, still riding the earnings.

points.event: Fell as the margin outlook sank in
points.comment: ==Volume== was light. Selling does not seem to have spread.

points.event: Won back about half of the drop
points.comment: Quiet trading while waiting for the next catalyst.
